title: Search with typeahead (autocomplete)
summary: Suggestions appear as the user types, in under 100ms perceived latency: debounce, cancel stale requests, cache prefixes, blend on-device results (recents, contacts) with server results, and never show out-of-order responses.
requirements: Suggestions for each keystroke after 1-2 characters; results page on submit.
Recent searches, on-device matches, server suggestions; works partially offline.
Low data usage; correct ordering of results.
components: Query pipeline: normalize → debounce (~150-300ms) → cache lookup → network → merge
Prefix cache (LRU) keyed by normalized query; reuse results of a longer cached prefix for filtering
On-device index: recents (SQLite FTS) and a trie for contacts/commands
Server: suggestion service backed by a precomputed prefix → top-k map (trie or sorted keys) with popularity ranking
Analytics: suggestion shown/selected for ranking feedback
tradeoffs: Shorter debounce feels faster but sends more requests; adapt by network speed.
Server-side personalization improves relevance but needs user context and is less cacheable at the CDN.
Client-side filtering of a cached broader prefix is instant but may miss server re-ranking.
body: **Out-of-order responses:** cancel the previous task when a new query starts and tag responses with the query; ignore results whose query is not the current text.
**Cache:** query 'swi' result can seed 'swif' instantly by filtering, while the network refines.
**UI:** keep the list stable while typing (avoid flicker); highlight matched prefix; keyboard return submits full search.
**Server scale:** top-k per prefix precomputed offline and cached at the edge; popular prefixes served from CDN; personalization layered in a second call.
**Accessibility:** announce result count changes with VoiceOver, support Dynamic Type.
